decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed was significantly cluttered with non-backpack items such as camping stoves, leather remnants, and travel pillows, which made the browsing experience frustrating. In my consideration set, I evaluated several actual backpacks, but found significant quality issues in the reviews. The Granite Gear (prod_backpacks_041) and the Hebetag (prod_backpacks_101) both had reviews mentioning shoulder straps breaking or tearing shortly after purchase. The W WINTMING tactical pack also had reports of broken buckles. While the USGI Alice Pack (prod_backpacks_005) is a reliable design, its price point of $339.99 for a used item was prohibitively high. The Mubasel hydration pack was the best-rated, but is too specialized for general-purpose use. Due to the lack of a durable, reasonably priced general-purpose hiking or daily pack, I decided not to make a purchase.
